· 현재가(172,200원) vs SMA5(187,440원)/SMA20(206,025원)/SMA50(231,330원): 단기·중기 추세 하회, 약세 국면

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-67.8124→-1453.4545): 약세 확산, 데드크로스 이후 하락 지속

· 스윙 저항선 (209,000원): SMA20/볼린저밴드 중단 부근, 단기 저항 구간
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보): 가격 변동성 축소, 방향성 부재
[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (172,200 KRW) vs SMA5 (187,440 KRW)/SMA20 (206,025 KRW)/SMA50 (231,330 KRW): below short/mid-term trends, bearish phase
· Position relative to SMA100 (244,890 KRW)/SMA200 (238,088 KRW): below long-term trends, deepening bearishness
· 52-week position (27.3%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.5→31.2): entered oversold territory, downward momentum continues
· MACD histogram trajectory (-67.8124→-1453.4545): bearishness expanding, decline continues after dead cross
· Bollinger Band current price position (lower band 170,568 KRW): approaching lower band, oversold pressure
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (167,300 KRW): aligns with 5-day/20-day lows, short-term support expected
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW): near SMA20/mid-band, short-term resistance zone
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways): reduced price volatility, lack of directionality
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.68x): below average volume, weak buying interest
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): potential for further decline due to RSI entering oversold and MACD bearish expansion; low reliability of rebound due to subdued volume, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
